metadata.title: Should You 'Buy' or 'Sell' Palantir Stock Before Aug. 3 Earnings?

content.text:
This article first appeared on GuruFocus.
Palantir Technologies (NASDAQ:PLTR) is all set to report its Q2 earnings on Aug. 3 after the U.S. market close, and the release could be one of the most closely watched AI events of the season.
After a huge rally over the past year, investors are now asking whether the software company can deliver results strong enough to justify its premium valuation.
PLTR has been one of the market's best-performing AI stocks, driven by rapid adoption of its Artificial Intelligence Platform (AIP), expanding government contracts, and accelerating commercial demand. Recent wins in defense and enterprise AI have kept optimism high, but expectations are equally elevated. Any sign of slowing growth or softer guidance could trigger a sharp reaction.
Wall Street expects Palantir to report earnings per share of about $0.16 on revenue of roughly $1.08 billion for the June quarter, representing another period of strong double-digit growth. Investors will pay close attention to U.S. commercial revenue, remaining deal value, AI platform adoption, and management's full-year outlook.
The options market is signaling a sizable post-earnings move of around 8%, reflecting uncertainty over whether Palantir can continue exceeding lofty expectations. Analysts say the stock's rich valuation leaves little room for disappointment, while another earnings beat accompanied by stronger guidance could extend the rally.
Wall Street remains divided. Bulls argue Palantir's AI leadership and expanding customer base support further upside, while skeptics believe the stock already prices in years of future growth. For investors, the Aug. 3 earnings report may determine whether PLTR remains an AI market favorite or faces a valuation reset.
Analysts Opinion on PLTR STock
Based on the consensus recommendation from 33 brokerage firms, Palantir Technologies Inc's (NASDAQ:PLTR) average brokerage recommendation is currently 2.1, indicating a "Outperform" status. The rating scale ranges from 1 to 5, where 1 signifies Strong Buy, and 5 denotes Sell.
Based on the one year price targets offered by 26 analysts, the average target price for Palantir Technologies Inc is $185.36 with a high estimate of $255.00 and a low estimate of $70.00. The average target implies a upside of +50.05% from the current price of $123.53.
Based on GuruFocus estimates, the estimated GF Value for Palantir Technologies Inc in one year is $221.11, suggesting a upside of +78.99% from the current price of $123.53.
